play_3_customer_match_audience.size_check: 115 contacts to upload, at or above the 100 active matched users a list needs to serve, but business emails often match poorly, so the list may still sit below 100 once matched. Read size_for_search and size_for_display two days after the upload; below 100 it won't serve yet.
play_3_customer_match_audience.policy_check: First-party: every contact came from the team's own sales process. Confirm the privacy policy says customer data is shared with service providers such as Google. GB contacts without recorded consent are left out.
play_3_customer_match_audience.eligibility_check: The user says the account has run since 2023 with about USD 180,000 lifetime spend: over 90 days and USD 50,000, so the list can be used for targeting as well as observation and exclusions.
play_3_customer_match_audience.what_to_run: Responsive search and display ads that lead with the shipped features and the Portfolio plan, which answer 9 of the 48 deals in the list, on a small daily budget. Campaign build left to the user or retargeting-sequence-designer if installed.
